intro: Renzik "The Shiv" is a goblin operative and the trusted second-in-command of SI:7, stationed inside their headquarters in Stormwind City's Old Town. He serves Spymaster Mathias Shaw faithfully, directing the new rogue recruits sent to him from across the Alliance.

p: Renzik keeps the story of his past to himself. What Stormwind knows is that this goblin found his way into SI:7 and now stands as Spymaster Mathias Shaw's second in command. He is short on patience and pleasantries, greeting new recruits by asking whether they are ready to get to work or need a nap first.

Now based inside the secretive SI:7 fortress in Old Town, Renzik serves as Mathias Shaw's second-in-command. Rogue mentors across the Alliance, from Ironforge to Darnassus, send their most promising agents to Renzik. Rather than sending them straight to slaughter, Renzik forwards them to field instructors like Lucius in Redridge to hone their survival craft.
